test_title: PYST 33: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Mathematics (Held On: 19 Jun, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: In ΔABC, DE ∥ AC, where D and E are the points on sides AB and BC, respectively. If BD = 2 cm and AD = 19 cm, then what is the ratio of the area of ΔBDE to the trapezium ADEC?
solution: **Given:** BD = 2 cm AD = 19 cm **Formula used:** area(BDE)/area(BAC) = (BD/BA)²; area(ADEC) = area(BAC) − area(BDE)
